brief_item_drafter_item_has_wording.name: brief_item_drafter_item_has_wording
brief_item_drafter_item_has_wording.value: "brief_item"."item_key" IS NOT NULL OR "brief_item"."content" IS NOT NULL

brief_item_decide_together_has_no_value.name: brief_item_decide_together_has_no_value
brief_item_decide_together_has_no_value.value: "brief_item"."pending" IS DISTINCT FROM 'decide_together' OR "brief_item"."value" IS NULL

brief_item_subject_pending_is_open_param.name: brief_item_subject_pending_is_open_parameter
brief_item_subject_pending_is_open_param.value: "brief_item"."pending" IS DISTINCT FROM 'subject' OR "brief_item"."shape" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'open_parameter'

brief_item_open_parameter_state.name: brief_item_open_parameter_state
brief_item_open_parameter_state.value: "brief_item"."shape" IS DISTINCT FROM 'open_parameter' OR ("brief_item"."pending" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'subject' AND "brief_item"."value" IS NULL) OR ("brief_item"."pending" IS NULL AND "brief_item"."value" IS NOT NULL)

live_brief_fingerprint_iff_signing.name: live_brief_fingerprint_iff_signing
live_brief_fingerprint_iff_signing.value: ("live_brief"."phase" = 'signing') = ("live_brief"."fingerprint" IS NOT NULL) AND ("live_brief"."fingerprint" IS NULL OR "live_brief"."fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

contract_signature_ip_is_host.name: contract_signature_ip_is_host
contract_signature_ip_is_host.value: "contract_signature"."ip" IS NULL OR masklen("contract_signature"."ip") = CASE WHEN family("contract_signature"."ip") = 4 THEN 32 ELSE 128 END

comp_card_draft_slots_distinct.name: comp_card_draft_slots_distinct
comp_card_draft_slots_distinct.value: "comp_card_draft"."slot_hero" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_full_body" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_hero" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_profile_view" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_hero" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_lifestyle" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_hero" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_beauty" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_full_body" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_profile_view" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_full_body" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_lifestyle" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_full_body" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_beauty" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_profile_view" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_lifestyle" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_profile_view" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_beauty" and "comp_card_draft"."slot_lifestyle" <> "comp_card_draft"."slot_beauty"

portfolio_draft_items_bounded.name: portfolio_draft_items_bounded
portfolio_draft_items_bounded.value: cardinality("portfolio_draft"."items") = 0 or (cardinality("portfolio_draft"."items") <= 8 and array_ndims("portfolio_draft"."items") = 1 and array_lower("portfolio_draft"."items", 1) = 1)
